title: House set to discuss amendments to proposed 2027 budget

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Lawmakers will publicly discuss amendments to the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget, as the House of Representatives is set to take up the budget bill for plenary discussions on Tuesday. A sub-committee with members from major political parties and the minority bloc are expected to meet late this week or early next week to hammer out proposed tweaks to House Bill No. 10858, the 2027 spending measure that was submitted by the House Appropriations Committee to the floor on Monday for debate, according to Nueva Ecija Rep.
